prefix.content: Add an exact-output regression for a Click command with a long help paragraph. At terminal width 48 the paragraph should wrap deterministically. This is a test-only change.
I set COLUMNS=48 in my shell and drafted runner.invoke(cli, ["--help"]) with no width argument. I was going to adjust the production help paragraph until the local output matched.
Before making changes, describe the next concrete plan for this test.

last_user_turn: Before making changes, describe the next concrete plan for this test.

convention.title: Pin help wrapping at the invocation boundary
points: Pass terminal_width=48 explicitly to CliRunner.invoke for the help request.
Do not rely on the host terminal size or a COLUMNS environment mutation for this exact-width test.
Assert successful exit and the expected wrapping for that width without changing production help formatting to make the test pass.
convention.scope: Exact help-wrapping regression tests for a requested terminal width; not general terminal discovery or production layout changes.

held_out_correction: Please fix the test boundary, not the production paragraph. Pass terminal_width=48 to invoke, avoid host or COLUMNS dependence, and check successful help output with the expected wrapping.
